i.norm: Tests that Frequency.getMode() handles Float special values (NaN and infinities) correctly. NaN values cannot be compared with natural ordering, so they are treated as a distinct group. The mode returns values ordered by frequency (descending), with ties broken by natural order. NaN floats appear last in the mode list.
Build a frequency table with Float special values. Counts: NaN=3, NEGATIVE_INFINITY=3, POSITIVE_INFINITY=3

All three special-value groups have the same frequency (3), so all appear in the mode list. The natural Float order puts NEGATIVE_INFINITY first, POSITIVE_INFINITY second, and NaN last (NaN is unordered by definition).
